description: Prepare a bounded TaskMarket delegation for research, coding, data collection, benchmarking, or verification. Requires chain_id, token_address, deliverable, reward, deadline, and an explicit maximum-spend ceiling. Reads public chain metadata. Returns the canonical TaskMarket API payload and approval summary without creating a task, holding a wallet, or spending funds.

chain_id.description: Explicit served chain id; no default.

deliverable.description: The exact artifact or result the worker must return.

max_spend_base_units.description: Explicit reward ceiling in the same chain/token's integer base units. No exchange conversion.

max_spend_usdc.description: Explicit user-authorized reward ceiling in USDC.

request.description: The external work needed, written as a clear task.

reward_base_units.description: Exact gross reward in the selected token's integer base units. Use with max_spend_base_units.

reward_usdc.description: Proposed worker reward in USDC, up to 6 decimal places.

token_address.description: Explicit payment token contract on that chain, checked against current network.info.

name: plan_taskmarket_delegation
